description.html: The 20 cm Nomoy Pet tweezers are made of stainless steel and designed for feeding reptiles and small jobs in the terrarium. With tweezers you offer food right in front of the animal while your hand stays at a safe distance, which reduces the risk of an accidental bite and stress in shy animals.

The 20 cm length is handy for smaller terrariums and for species such as leopard geckos, crested geckos and juveniles, where precision matters more than reach. For larger and deeper terrariums, or species with a strong bite, the longer 30 cm tweezers are a better fit.

Hold the insect gently by the middle of its body and offer it calmly in front of the animal. You can also use the tweezers to remove leftover food, droppings or shed skin, and to arrange plants and decor.

After each feed, wash the tweezers with warm water and detergent, and disinfect them from time to time, especially if you use them for several terrariums. Stainless steel is easy to look after. Find other accessories in our equipment range.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
